title: Air Tag Along
tagline: Air Tag Along helps you find like-minded travelers heading to the same airport as you using AI
description:
Air Tag Along – Find Your Perfect Travel Buddy ✈️

Traveling alone? Air Tag Along connects you with fellow travelers heading to the same airport or destination. Whether you want company for your flight, a shared ride to the airport, or someone to explore during a layover, our AI-powered matchmaking makes finding the right travel buddy effortless.

How It Works

🔹 Post Your Trip – Enter your departure and arrival airports, flight date, and preferences.

🔹 AI Matchmaking – Our smart AI suggests compatible travelers based on shared routes, interests, and travel habits.

🔹 Connect & Travel Together – Chat, plan, and make your journey more enjoyable with your matched travel buddy.

Why Use Air Tag Along?

✅ Never Travel Alone – Meet like-minded travelers for your journey. 

✅ AI-Powered Matching – Get smart suggestions for the best travel buddy.
how_its_made:
This project utilizes React.js and Tailwind CSS. The backend was built using Node.js and Express.js. The travelers' data is stored on Secret Vault. I used the Hello World AVS template to build the AVS and an AI agent to verify whether the event location is real before it gets put on-chain.

The following technologies were used:

- Nillion: I used Secret Vault to store travelers' data.
- EigenLayer: I used the Hello World AVS template to build the AVS and AI agent.
